property.name: filterFieldName
property.label: Search Field (API)
property.description: API field used by the backend for text search

property.name: accountNamePath
property.label: Account Name/Id Path
property.description: Path used for account filtering, e.g., Order.Account.Id or AccountId

property.name: manualFieldApiNames
property.label: Manual Field API Names
property.description: CSV with API field paths, e.g., Order.OrderNumber, OrderItemNumber, PMC_CPQ_LinePONumber__c

property.name: manualFieldLabelNames
property.label: Manual Field Labels (CSV)
property.description: Column labels in the same order as Manual Field API Names, e.g., 'Label 1, Label 2, Label 3'

property.name: tableType
property.label: Report Name/Datatable Type
property.description: Used to identify table behavior, e.g., In Transit or Documents

property.name: baseWhereClause
property.label: Base WHERE (SOQL fragment)
property.description: Without the word WHERE, e.g., Order.Status = 'Activated'
